description: Lists dated articles with summaries, category and tag filters, pagination and a reader.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-asciidoc-blog page-size="2">
  <script type="tp/asciidoc">
    == A small garden

    Id:: garden
    Date:: 2026-06-03
    Summary:: Three ideas for a greener balcony.
    Categories:: Life
    Tags:: plants, outdoors

    Start with herbs, choose a sunny spot, and water regularly.

    == Learning together

    Id:: learning
    Date:: 2026-06-02
    Summary:: Notes from our first workshop.
    Categories:: Learning
    Tags:: community, ideas

    A short shared exercise makes a good starting point for discussion.

    == Welcome

    Id:: welcome
    Date:: 2026-06-01
    Summary:: What you will find in this blog.
    Categories:: Life
    Tags:: community

    We share practical ideas and small discoveries. Come back for the next article.
  </script>
</tp-asciidoc-blog>

attributes.name: article
attributes.description: Article identifier to open; empty shows the filtered list.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Exact category filter; empty includes every category.

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: One-based list page, clamped to the filtered page count.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Maximum articles per list page; positive integers only, otherwise five.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of the markup index; relative article paths resolve against this file.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Exact tag filter; combined with the category filter.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Inline markup index, used when src is absent; takes precedence over the internal script.

events.name: tp-asciidoc-blog-error
events.description: Emitted when loading or parsing fails; message describes the failure.

events.name: tp-asciidoc-blog-load
events.description: Emitted after the index is parsed successfully; count is the number of articles.

events.name: tp-asciidoc-blog-open
events.description: Emitted after an article is displayed; id identifies the article.

dependencies.name: tp-markup-blog
dependencies.summary: Paginated markup articles with category and tag filters.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-asciidoc-blog>` element lists dated articles with summaries, category and tag filters, pagination and a reader.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Article title | Open the complete article in the reader. |
| Categories and Tags | Filter the list; both filters apply together and reset pagination. All removes that filter. |
| Previous / Next | Browse the filtered article pages. |
| Back to articles | Return to the same filters and page. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between filters, article titles and page buttons. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button or filter option. |
| Arrow keys in a radio group | Select another category or tag using the radio group's standard controls. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open help for the hovered component, falling back to focus; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component in the hovered or focused hierarchy before opening help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS. |
